method: P4 autos (ACC/B1G/B12/SEC) + one G6 auto by engine power + power-aware at-larges → neutral-site playoff WP from power gap. Sim-derived. Not book prices. Not an ESPN bracket copy.

assumptions.auto_bids: ACC + Big Ten + Big 12 + SEC champs + one G6 auto by power
assumptions.g6_auto: highest-ranked G6 conference champion by power_index
assumptions.precision: 1 decimal when N>=1000 else integer percent
